introText: Despite an extensive scrape of public data, a few gaps and ambiguities remain.

confidenceLevels.label: Confirmed
confidenceLevels.description: Directly supported by primary sources or on-page evidence; includes hard facts (numbers, quotes) with citations.

confidenceLevels.label: Estimated/Inference
confidenceLevels.description: Inferred or estimated with some basis (comparables, secondary clues, logical trends); used for forward-looking statements and un-scrapable metrics like Instagram follower size.

confidenceLevels.label: Weak/Sparse Evidence
confidenceLevels.description: Used where data was minimal, inaccessible, or ambiguous; includes paraphrased Reddit excerpts and educated guesses (e.g., possible low Facebook activity).

limitations.title: Instagram Metrics Unavailable
limitations.description: Anti-scraping and login requirements blocked access to follower and engagement counts; Instagram follower size is ⚠️ estimated from secondary clues; precise figures require a direct mobile/app check; qualitative observations used instead of hard metrics.

limitations.title: Private/Deleted Social Content
limitations.description: Sentiment in private groups, Stories, or since-deleted posts may be missing; no evidence of major viral mishaps was found; analysis focuses on content publicly accessible at the time of research.

limitations.title: Reddit Data Interpretation
limitations.description: Relied on JSON excerpts from search; some quotes are paraphrased and exact wording may vary due to archival/removal; an API-driven historical pull could surface more mentions; this study used keyword search to capture main points.

limitations.title: Sales Figures Not Disclosed
limitations.description: Cited directional stats (e.g., 5,000 cases in year two; +20% YTD growth) from media/interviews; absolute volumes and financials for Ghost Spirits LLC are not public; outdated fundraising targets (2019) were not used for current figures.

limitations.title: No Quantified Share of Voice
limitations.description: Per scope, no cross-brand share-of-voice or sentiment ratio calculation was attempted; co-mentions with competitors are observational and not frequency-based; no market share estimates were made.

limitations.title: Entity Ambiguity Around 'Ghost'
limitations.description: Some 'ghost tequila' mentions refer to Gran Agave’s ghost-shaped bottle or Ghost Energy; approximately 5–7 such results were identified and excluded; 'ghost pepper tequila' was mapped to the brand unless another label (e.g., El Nivel) was explicitly named.

limitations.title: Sparse Reviews for Reposado
limitations.description: Very limited public reviews for the Reposado (e.g., a single panel rating on Tequila Matchmaker; no Distiller entry); most sentiment centers on the Blanco; analysis treats 'Ghost Tequila' primarily at the brand level rather than by expression.

limitations.title: Lack of Granular Engagement/Conversion Data
limitations.description: No access to internal metrics such as conversions, repeat purchase, or CRM data; visible likes/comments/shares were used as surface-level proxies; deeper insight would require brand-owned analytics.

limitations.title: Time Sensitivity of Snapshot
limitations.description: Findings represent a snapshot as of 2026-04-14; social metrics and sentiment evolve quickly; sources are date-cited, with most data points anchored in late 2025 to early 2026.

metadata.method: Extensive public-web scraping and citation-based review: keyword searches; manual validation; interpretation of Reddit JSON snippets; exclusion of ambiguous 'ghost' entities; observational comparisons without share-of-voice quantification; reliance on visible social interactions.
metadata.note: Instagram metrics could not be verified due to anti-scraping; where confirmation was not possible, uncertainty was explicitly stated or the claim omitted. Data reflects late-2025 to early-2026 public, reproducible sources.

closingText: Despite minor gaps, the profile is grounded in publicly verifiable evidence, with uncertainties clearly flagged; another researcher following the cited sources and approach should reach a substantially similar view.
